item.description:
New in 0.1.8

A polish release. Lots of small things that were slightly off are now right, and rule badges learned a genuinely useful trick.

  • Opens on your week. A fresh launch now lands on week zoom with today at the left edge, instead of a zoomed-in day. While the app stays open your view stays where you left it.
  • Badges can open links. A rule badge can now be a button. In the rule editor, turn on "Badge opens the event's first link" and clicking the badge on an event jumps straight to its link, the Zoom call, the booking page, whatever the event carries. Add a match pattern to pick a specific link, like zoom.us, when an event has several. If no link is found the click just opens the event as usual.
  • Who is coming. Invitees now show their reply the way you would expect: a green check for accepted, red for declined, a quiet question mark for no reply yet, with the organizer and optional guests labeled.
  • Long notes scroll. Notes that used to clip past a few lines now scroll inside the popover, including on read-only calendars. Provider-generated novels are finally readable in place.
  • Snappier event popover. Typing in the event editor no longer drags while the timeline animates behind it.
  • Header labels pin properly. The day and hour labels now stick to the left edge with a clean backing, the way the month label always has. No more clipped digits hanging off the edge.
  • A nicer front door. The unlock screen has been redesigned, with a wider key field so your whole license key is visible when you paste it.
  • Emoji badges, unboxed. An emoji badge now stands on its own instead of being squeezed into a colored disc.
  • Quieter tooltips. Toolbar tooltips are now just the name and the hotkey. The Guide keeps the full explanations, and now lists the N key for follow mode.

Feedback

Send anything, bugs, ideas, confusion, to evan@trytimecal.com.
